instruction: Launch the video file from my desktop using VLC player.

files.path: /home/user/Desktop/Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mp4

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

rules.file_name: Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mp4

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to initiate playback of the desktop video file in VLC media player. Evaluator uses is_vlc_playing to query VLC's HTTP interface and confirm both active playback state and filename match for the Rick Astley music video.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_vlc_playing_info queries VLC HTTP interface and returns status XML with playback state and filename
Metric logic is correct: is_vlc_playing properly checks both playing state (state=='playing') and filename match
Complete instruction coverage: Verifies both that VLC is playing AND playing the correct desktop video file
Correct parameter handling: Metric receives 'rule' parameter directly (not 'expected'), matching framework behavior when expected.type='rule'
Expected value is semantically correct: Filename matches the downloaded video file from config
Robust implementation: Multiple XML path fallbacks for filename extraction, good edge case handling (VLC not playing, HTTP failures, missing filename)
State is accessible: VLC HTTP interface is enabled and remains running during evaluation
